name: @loom/db-observability
description: A dynamic database-observability dashboard: a user's natural-language question is analysed by an agent, categorised into a topic + a WHAT (the direct answer) and WHY (the supporting explanation), and a Loom blueprint UI is GENERATED DYNAMICALLY from an available widget catalogue bound to live telemetry projections. Renders headlessly via renderer-terminal AND as a React dashboard (Recharts) via renderer-react — the same blueprint, two surfaces.
